integrity: The 1977 autonomous shunted-junction source was inspected through its equation, first article page, abstract, phase-plane/current-voltage scope, and final references. A complete open 2023 same-equation mathematical article was inspected through the defining Josephson equation, cylinder formulation, transformations, limit-cycle theorems, bifurcation discussion, and references; targeted full-text searches found no average, variance, covariance, or stationary-measure formulation matching the accepted theorem. The 1968 Stewart record was used for provenance and the earliest verified day-resolved public date rather than for whole-document noncoverage. The conditional law, power identity, variance parabola, residual-energy defect, equality classification, and overcritical floor were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the autonomous constant-damping normalized Josephson equation and compactly supported invariant probability measures.
The strict parameter-only mean-voltage floor is proved for overcritical bias \(I>1\).
The theorem does not determine a unique current-voltage branch or the full invariant distribution.
The 1968 foundational source was checked from its bibliographic record and abstract rather than a complete local full-text copy.
The 2020 global-dynamics article was compared through its abstract and its detailed use in a complete later same-equation article.

A short equivalent power balance could remain implicit in older Josephson literature; the originality claim concerns the combined conditional regression, variance defect, endpoint rigidity, and strict overcritical floor.
title: Exact voltage parabola and an overcritical mean-voltage floor in the autonomous Josephson equation
